title: Setup Sheet + Cycle Time Prediction
description: Wire SetupSheetFromGCodeEngine and CycleTimeEstimatorEngine to productDispatcher with standalone API routes and web UI pages. Setup sheet auto-extracts tools, offsets, coolant, safety notes from G-code. Cycle time uses S-curve kinematics, corner deceleration, servo settling. Multi-machine comparison finds the fastest machine for a program.
